Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:47613
Court No. - 11
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5313 of 2023

Applicant :- Imran
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.Prin.Secy. Home Deptt.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Salman,Avnish Kumar Tiwari,Mohd. Mubeen

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State of U.P. and perused the record.
2.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No.568 of 2022, under Sections 366 and 376-D I.P.C., Police Station-Pihani, District-Hardoi, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
3. The F.I.R. in question was lodged alleging the commission of offence under Section 366 I.P.C.,

subsequently, in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she has favoured the applicant and in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., allegations of the offence were leveled against the applicant and one-Mohmmad Ahmad.

sentences.text: Learned Counsel for the applicant argues that the co-accused, namely-Mohammad Ahmad against whom similar allegations have been leveled has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 18.05.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.4350 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.4350 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He further argues that the applicant is in custody since 26.01.2023 and has criminal antecedent one case registered as Case Crime No.323 of 2018 under Section 376, 323 and 504 I.P.C. lodged by the sister of the present victim, in which the applicant has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 12.09.2019 passed in Bail No.5037 of 2019.
5. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
6. Considering the submissions made at the Bar and the fact that there is variance in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.

The co-accused, namely-Mohammad Ahmad against whom similar allegations have been leveled has been enlarged on bail and also considering the fact that statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. in which, she has favoured the applicant, as such, the applicant is enlarged on bail.
7. In view thereof, the present bail application is allowed.
8. Let the applicant-Imran, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in Court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the Trial Court on each date fixed,
either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the Trial Court may proceed against him under Section 229-A IPC.
(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and

if applicant fails to appear before the Court on the date fixed in such proclamation,
then, the Trial Court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law,
under Section 174-A IPC.
(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the Trial Court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. If in the opinion of the Trial Court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
